label: FortiGate 90G firewall
description: Fortinet FortiGate 90G - branch NGFW (2.5 Gbps NGFW / 2.2 Gbps threat protection): eight 10/100/1000BASE-T RJ45 ports (port1-port6 plus a and b, which are the FortiLink pair) and two shared-media WAN positions that accept either a 10G/5G/2.5G/1G copper RJ45 port or a 10G/1G SFP+ cage. WAN1 and SFP+1 are the same physical connector, as are WAN2 and SFP+2, so only one half of each pair can carry a cable.
notes: Fortinet FortiGate 90G and 91G fast path architecture: "Two 10 GigE SFP+ interfaces (SFP+1 and SFP+2) connect to the SOC5 integrated switch fabric through a shared media connector. Two 10GigE/5GigE/2.5GigE/1GigE/100M BASE-T RJ45 interfaces (WAN1 and WAN2) ... Eight 10/100/1000BASE-T RJ45 (1-6, A, and B) ... A and B are FortiLink interfaces." The `diagnose npu np7lite port-list` output names them wan1, wan2, port1-port6, a, b - which is why the eight internal ports are port1-port6 plus a and b and not port1-port8. The 90G series data sheet's hardware table confirms 2 x 10/5/2.5/GE RJ45 or 10GE/GE SFP+/SFP shared media pairs and 8 x GE RJ45 internal ports. wan1/wan2 used to be declared 2.5G, which understated a port that the interface list rates at 10 Gbps copper.
